text: The Russian Federation is Gazprom's ultimate controlling party and holds a controlling stake of over 50%, directly and through companies it controls.

source.name: PJSC Gazprom: IFRS consolidated interim condensed financial information, 31 March 2025 (unaudited), note 1 (archived copy of gazprom.com PDF)
source.quote: The Russian Federation is the ultimate controlling party and has a controlling interest (including both direct and indirect ownership) of over 50 % in PJSC Gazprom.

additionalSources.name: AK&M Information Agency: Gazprom's net profit under IFRS for 2025 increased by 7%
additionalSources.quote: The Russian Federation, being the party with ultimate control, has a controlling stake (including direct and indirect ownership) of over 50% in Gazprom PJSC.
